ShortDescription.Value: Bike and scooter tuning. Moving path controls to Adjust All Speed Limits (ASL).

Publish.LongDescription:
## Moving to Adjust All Speed Limits (ASL)
**[Get Adjust All Speed Limits](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/149990/Windows)**
ASL 1.3.0 adds independent Bike and Pedestrian path speed controls in its in-city Paths tab.
- B+P keeps its existing tuning if you use it alone. - With ASL's new Paths feature installed, B+P automatically leaves path speed limits to ASL, even during resets. - When ASL provides bike and scooter vehicle speed tuning, B+P leaves that to ASL too. - B+P sliders remain saved. For matching speeds, 2.00 in B+P = 200% in ASL. - Before switching, load your city with B+P alone, set Path speed limit to 1.00, let it finish and save. This helps restore legacy path changes, including hidden vehicle paths. Then install ASL and set your desired speeds. - B+P's status reports remain available.
🚴 **Path speed limit** - adjust bike and pedestrian paths (paths are independent of road speed limits).
🚲 **Bike speeds** decrease or increase bicycles + electric scooters. Speed can be disabled [ ] if you just want the Paths.
🚴 **Status report** - compare Bike count versus Cars count + usage (Stats can be used without enabling Bikes or Path speed checkbox ✅ at all).
### Features - ✅ Speed ⬆️ ⬇️ - ✅ Smoothing math for acceleration + braking (no teleport or panic braking) - ✅ One-click Reset buttons.
---
## Tech notes - Road speed limits and game conditions may still cap speeds on bikes in normal roads. - Path speed limit - for both bike and pedestrian paths. - When ASL controls a speed category, B+P does not write or reset that category. - To disable the mod without uninstalling, uncheck [ ] the enable box. - Safe to remove (Reset button first for fast return to game defaults, then save city, and uninstall). If you don't reset, it's not a problem, you keep the changed paths until you replace your paths since they are vanilla paths.
### Support and Feedback - Suppoer by clicking the Like 👍 button (top right). - Report issues on Github or Discord, link icons on the right.
### Design + Performance - Bikes + Paths is built to be lightweight. It's partly why this was made; to have a mod that does not have parts that run in the city per-frame all the time. - No Harmony patch. It works to apply tuning when you change settings (or when a city loads), then goes idle, simple. - Status report refreshes only when the Options menu is open (to not affect city gameplay performance). - This is a brief idea, there is much more; be sure, effort is made for these details because I like the idea I can run these kind of mods even on an old laptop.
#### Supports 11+ languages: Hello, Bonjour, Hola, Hallo, Ciao, こんにちは, 안녕하세요, Cześć, Olá, 你好, 你好, Merhaba, Xin chào
